item.title: American democracy was a big winner in the midterms
item.description: Results are still outstanding House and Senate races but political scientists say one of the big winners in the mid-terms is American democracy itself.

item.title: Why Latino voters swung blue this year
item.description: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly talks with Sabrina Rodriguez, politics reporter for the Wall Street Journal, about the role Latino voters played in the midterm election.

item.title: Cornell faculty passes vote of no-confidence in university administration
item.description: Cornell University's faculty is voting on a no-confidence resolution, condemning the school's administration handling of an alleged gang rape.

item.title: Busy Philipps talks about treating her brain tumor and filming a new show
item.description: On Wild Card, Philipps unpacks the experience of treating her brain tumor and filming her new show, the CBS drama Cupertino. But she also opened up about another aspect of her life.

item.title: 'All Things Considered' bids farewell to host Mary Louise Kelly
item.description: All Things Considered bids farewell to Mary Louise Kelly, who hosts her final show Friday after an NPR career that goes back 25 years.

item.title: What to know about Gina Hinojosa, Texas' first Latina governor-elect
item.description: Gina Hinojosa, state representative from the Rio Grande Valley whose legislative priority has been boosting the public education system, will become the first Latina governor of Texas.

item.title: How octopuses squeeze through teeny tiny holes
item.description: Robots used during search and rescue operations need to be able to wriggle through narrow cracks and crevices. Researchers have turned to a natural contortionist for inspiration — the octopus.

item.title: The Cybertruck's 'cause of death?' Insufficient demand
item.description: One of the most polarizing vehicles to hit the road will soon be a thing of history. Tesla will wind down manufacturing of its Cybertruck at the company's Gigafactory Texas mid-next year.

item.title: Stephen Miller replaces Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff
item.description: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles is being replaced by Stephen Miller, President Trump said Friday. The change comes after Republicans were swept out of power in the midterm elections.

item.title: A former FBI chief in Chicago sues top Trump officials over a botched immigration case
item.description: Chicago's former FBI chief is suing the U.S. district attorney in the city and a federal judge has ordered that prosecutor to testify about claims he's made about charging protesters.
